note: 🤖 AGENT LIVE GUIDE — machine-readable blob cinema. Fetch this to discover streams.

protocol.chunks: Fetch from https://aggregator.walrus-testnet.walrus.space/v1/blobs/<blob_id>. Chunk 0 is the webm init segment; append to MSE SourceBuffer('video/webm;codecs=vp9'), then append chunks in order.
protocol.encryption: NaCl secretbox. Ciphertext = 24-byte nonce || secretbox(plaintext). Decrypt: split at 24, secretbox.open.
protocol.key_derivation: K_0 = live_key (hex). K_{n+1} = SHA256( K_n bytes + b'|next' ). Chunk n encrypted with K_n.
protocol.live: While a stream is live, poll the broadcaster's manifest. This guide updates on STOP.
protocol.proof: Each stream has a proof bundle: sha256(live_key | chunk blob IDs). Recompute to verify (hash-commitment, not zk-SNARK).
